rulesets.m: CRITICAL CAMERA — read this before anything else: the camera is ABOVE the creature, pitched 30 degrees DOWNWARD, rotated 45 degrees (orthographic 3/4 top-down quarter view). You must SEE THE CREATURE'S BACK and the TOP of its head and shoulders. Because you look down at it, the body is FORESHORTENED — it must NOT be stretched out flat like a side profile. A pure side view, a pure front view, or an eye-level view is WRONG and unusable. The reference image shows exactly this camera angle — copy that angle. Match the reference art style EXACTLY: hand-drawn pixel art, same dot size, thin dark outlines, soft cel shading. Not photorealistic, not 3D-rendered, no smooth gradients. Thick solid masses readable at 128px tall. LAYOUT: a 3-column by 2-row grid of 6 cells with clear empty magenta gaps between every cell. Every cell holds the SAME creature at the SAME scale and SAME camera angle, feet on a common baseline; only the pose differs. No grid lines, no labels, no text. COLOR: NEUTRAL DESATURATED GRAY-WHITE only, no hue. Background: flat solid pure magenta #FF00FF everywhere, no ground, no shadow, no scenery.

assets.name: p2_chaser_qv
assets.prompt: A 6-cell animation sprite sheet of ONE hostile creature seen from above at a 30-degree downward angle: a quadruped charging beast, low forward-leaning stance, head down, lean muscular build, its back and shoulder blades clearly visible from above. Cells: (1) idle standing, (2) idle weight shifted, (3) idle head raised, (4) walk step forward, (5) walk mid-stride, (6) walk pushing off.
